title: ChatGPT for Teens adds college planning, flashcards and easier quizzes
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT is adding study and college-planning tools for teens
summary: OpenAI plans to add a College Planner for U.S. high-school students and is rolling out better quiz, flashcard and multi-photo note tools. The planner will collect deadlines, requirements, financial-aid steps and application tasks in one place.
friendlySummary: Teens will be able to track college tasks and deadlines, make flashcards and turn notes into quizzes more easily.
whyItMatters: The feature targets the administrative work around college applications rather than replacing personal decisions or human advice. Families should still verify deadlines and financial details with schools and advisers.
friendlyWhyItMatters: These tools can reduce planning stress, but students should still check important information with schools, families and advisers.
